title: Babalar

characters.FATHER: a father in his forties with short dark hair and a grey mustache, wearing a brown work jacket
characters.GIRL: his daughter, a little girl of about six with two pigtails and a yellow dress
characters.WOMAN: a young woman of about twenty-five with long dark hair in a yellow coat

scenes.prompt: {FATHER} sits quietly at a kitchen table at dawn, drinking tea, looking out the window, thoughtful.
{FATHER} walks out of an apartment building in the early dark morning with a lunch box, street lamps still on, cold breath.
In a park, {FATHER} runs behind {GIRL}, who rides a small bicycle by herself for the first time, he has let go of the seat, both laughing.
At night in a child's bedroom lit by a small lamp, {FATHER} gently pulls the blanket over the sleeping {GIRL}.

scenes.text:
Bugün babana bir kez sarıl.
Söyleyemediğini anlar.
scenes.prompt: {WOMAN} hugs {FATHER}, now older with grey hair, at the door of the family home, he holds back tears with a small smile.

caption:
Babalar sevgiyi söylemez, yaşatır. 🤍

Babana bunu gönder ya da bugün bir kez sarıl.
